$comment: Industrial-core line and branch coverage floors (freellmpool.industrial + freellmpool.industrial_report) enforced independently by scripts/check_coverage.py at the agent-orchestrator level. CI must not run this gate (tests/test_ci_config.py::test_ci_has_no_legacy_coverage_gate_contract). Package modules outside the industrial RFQ product are out of scope.

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST generate industrial-core branch coverage and run the checker before marking any task complete or creating a PR. Lines and branches are evaluated separately. CI does not enforce this gate.
